g.text: New records are Task products. JSON reloads produce
plain records with the same persisted fields.
TodoService only requires the load/save shape.
Domain and controller know nothing about IdeaBox.
Same service surface, through structural typing.
Add operations log first; other members delegate.
No service or renderer code changes.
load(): read first member (active task list).
save(tasks): forward to every member in order.
Archive keeps the first-saved record per ID.
Cancel: never call the real delete operation.
OK: delegate through decorator to TodoService.
Domain, controller and renderer stay unchanged.
